props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: columnResizeMode
props.description: Resize mode for columns: live on drag ('onChange') or on release ('onEnd').

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions rendered when no external table instance is provided.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: Ref forwarded to the outer scroll container element.

props.name: currentColumnPinning
props.description: Controlled column pinning state in convenience mode.

props.name: currentExpanded
props.description: Controlled expanded rows state in convenience mode.

props.name: currentPagination
props.description: Controlled pagination state in convenience mode.

props.name: currentRowSelection
props.description: Controlled row selection state in convenience mode.

props.name: currentSorting
props.description: Controlled sorting state in convenience mode.

props.name: data
props.description: Reactive dataset or accessor rendered when no external table instance is provided.

props.name: defaultColumnPinning
props.description: Initial column pinning state in convenience mode.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded rows state in convenience mode.

props.name: defaultPagination
props.description: Initial pagination state (pageIndex, pageSize) in convenience mode.

props.name: defaultRowSelection
props.description: Initial row selection state when uncontrolled in convenience mode.

props.name: defaultSorting
props.description: Initial sorting state when uncontrolled in convenience mode.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description: Custom empty state content rendered when there are no rows.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Enable expandable rows in convenience mode.

props.name: expandColumn
props.description: Whether to automatically prepend an expand chevron toggle column.

default.text: true when expandable or expandedRowRender is provided

props.name: expandedRowRender
props.description: Custom content rendered inside the expanded sub-row.

props.name: hoverEffect
props.description: Highlight row on mouse hover.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description: Callback to determine if a specific row can be selected. When false, the row checkbox/radio is disabled.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the table is currently in a loading state.

props.name: loadingRender
props.description: Custom loading state content.

props.name: manualFiltering
props.description: Whether filtering is handled externally (remote / server-side).

props.name: manualPagination
props.description: Whether pagination is handled externally (remote / server-side).

props.name: manualSorting
props.description: Whether sorting is handled externally (remote / server-side).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height for the table scroll container (e.g. `400` or `'400px'`).

props.name: onColumnPinningChange
props.description: Callback fired when column pinning changes in convenience mode.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Callback fired when expanded rows change in convenience mode.

props.name: onPaginationChange
props.description: Callback fired when pagination changes in convenience mode.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Callback fired when a table body row is clicked.

props.name: onRowDoubleClick
props.description: Callback fired when a table body row is double-clicked.

props.name: onRowSelectionChange
props.description: Callback fired when row selection changes in convenience mode.

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Callback fired when sorting changes in convenience mode.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Available page size choices in the pagination dropdown.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Enable bottom pagination controls in convenience mode.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Enable column width resizing with drag handles.

props.name: rowClass
props.description: Custom class or class getter applied to each row (`<tr>`).

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Total row count for remote pagination.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Enable row selection checkboxes in convenience mode.

props.name: showBorder
props.description: Border divider layout.

props.name: showPageSize
props.description: Whether to show the page size selection dropdown menu in the pagination toolbar.

props.name: size
props.description: Size density of table cells, text, and padding.

props.name: sorting
props.description: Enable client-side column sorting in convenience mode.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Whether the table header sticks to the top of the container during scrolling.

props.name: striped
props.description: Alternating background shading on even rows.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: table
props.description: Existing TanStack Solid Table instance.

props.name: virtualRender
props.description: Component mounted inside `tbody` to render virtualized rows.
